overview: Build a Rust catalog crate that discovers scenario files deeply across configured sources and loads them concurrently with deterministic validation and aggregated error reporting, replacing fragile sequential TypeScript discovery logic.
goals: Provide a single catalog API for deep scenario discovery and loading
Support high-throughput concurrent loading with bounded resource usage
Return complete structured error sets instead of fail-fast behavior
Enable source-adapter extensibility without changing core orchestration
successMetrics: Load and parse 1000 valid scenario files in under 500ms on reference dev hardware
Malformed files are all reported in one run with file path and error detail
Adding a new source adapter requires no changes to catalog core module
Core catalog tests run without touching disk via in-memory source doubles
openQuestions: Will the crate live in this repository as a Cargo workspace member or external repository?
What exact scenario schema versioning policy should validation enforce?
Should ignore rules default to .gitignore only, or include custom ignore files too?
Should symlink traversal be disabled by default for security?
uiNotes: No UI routes are required; this is a backend library deliverable.
Public API should prioritize stable trait-based interfaces over presentation concerns.

importFormat.description: Catalog input is a set of YAML scenario files discovered from configured source roots and glob patterns.

rules: Discovery must recurse directories and apply include/exclude globs before loading.
Ignore files must be respected during discovery for filesystem source.
Concurrent reads must be bounded by a semaphore limit configurable per catalog instance.
Parsing/validation errors must not stop processing of remaining files.
Duplicate scenario IDs across loaded sources must return a deterministic conflict error.
Ordering of successful results should be deterministic (stable sort by source then path).

stories.title: Scaffold rust catalog crate and workspace wiring
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want a Rust crate scaffolded with tooling and scripts so catalog development is consistent and repeatable.
acceptanceCriteria: Create crate skeleton for `qtip-catalog` and wire it into repository build conventions.
Install required dependencies with explicit commands: `cargo add serde serde_yaml thiserror rayon tokio ignore globset tracing` and dev dependencies as needed for tests/benchmarks.
Add baseline Cargo configuration and lint/test scripts required by quality gates.
Example: running `cargo test --all --all-features` in a clean checkout executes crate test harness.
Negative case: missing toolchain or unresolved dependency produces actionable setup failure message in README/CONTRIBUTING notes.

stories.title: Define core domain types and trait ports
stories.description: As an integrator, I want stable domain structs and trait interfaces so source adapters and catalog orchestration can evolve independently.
acceptanceCriteria: Define core types: `ScenarioRef`, `ScenarioDocument`, `Scenario`, `CatalogError`, and result envelopes.
Define port traits for deep discovery and loading (for example, `ScenarioSource` and `ScenarioCatalog`) with explicit async/sync boundaries.
Example: a mock source implementing `ScenarioSource` can feed two in-memory files through trait methods.
Negative case: trait contract rejects invalid source records (empty path or missing source id) with structured error.

stories.title: Implement filesystem deep discovery adapter
stories.description: As a developer, I want filesystem discovery with recursive matching and ignore support so only intended scenario files are loaded.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement filesystem adapter that walks configured roots recursively with include/exclude patterns.
Respect `.gitignore` and explicit ignore patterns during traversal.
Example: nested `scenarios/auth/login-success.yaml` is discovered when include pattern is `**/*.yaml`.
Negative case: file under ignored path (for example `tmp/experimental.yaml`) is not returned by discovery.
Negative case: unreadable directory returns non-fatal `CatalogError` and traversal continues for other roots.

stories.title: Build concurrent loader with bounded I/O
stories.description: As a platform engineer, I want bounded concurrent loading so the catalog is fast without exhausting file descriptors.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement orchestrator that loads discovered files concurrently with configurable semaphore limits.
Use clear separation between async I/O and CPU-bound parse/validate stages.
Example: 500 files are loaded with concurrency limit 100 and all documents are returned.
Negative case: when limit is set to 1, processing remains correct (slower but no starvation/deadlock).
Negative case: source read failures are collected in `CatalogError` without aborting remaining loads.

stories.title: Add parsing and schema validation pipeline
stories.description: As a qtip developer, I want loaded documents parsed and validated into canonical scenarios so downstream execution receives trusted input.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse YAML scenario files into strongly typed domain model.
Validate required fields and semantic constraints (for example unique step ordering and required assertion fields).
Example: valid `login-success.yaml` yields canonical `Scenario` value.
Negative case: malformed YAML yields parse error with file path and stage `parse`.
Negative case: schema violation (missing `steps`) yields validation error with stage `validate`.

stories.title: Aggregate deterministic results and conflict detection
stories.description: As a CI engineer, I want deterministic ordering and conflict reporting so repeated runs are stable and actionable.
acceptanceCriteria: Return successful scenarios in deterministic order independent of concurrency timing.
Detect duplicate scenario IDs across files/sources and emit explicit conflict errors.
Example: same input set across two runs returns identical ordered output.
Negative case: duplicate ID across two files returns conflict error entries referencing both paths.
Negative case: if all inputs fail, response still returns complete error collection and empty success set.

stories.title: Add no-disk test harness with in-memory source
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want in-memory adapter tests so core behavior can be verified quickly without filesystem side effects.
acceptanceCriteria: Create in-memory source adapter used by unit tests for discovery/load orchestration.
Cover positive and negative paths for parsing, validation, ordering, and error aggregation.
Example: test with three in-memory files (two valid, one invalid) returns two scenarios and one error.
Negative case: empty in-memory source returns empty success set and zero errors without panic.

stories.title: Benchmark and document performance envelope
stories.description: As an engineering lead, I want repeatable benchmark evidence and operational guidance so adoption risk is measurable.
acceptanceCriteria: Add benchmark fixture and measurement script for deep discovery + load path.
Document baseline machine assumptions and observed throughput/latency with concurrency settings.
Example: benchmark report captures under-500ms target for 1000 valid files on baseline hardware.
Negative case: if benchmark target is missed, report clearly flags regression and includes profile hints.
